info.description: The conservation.tv agent API, served by the agent itself.

get.description: Whether the agent is up and serving requests.

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

get.description: Each runtime's live status, and whether it has accepted its latest spec. Live, never stored: after a restart it is rebuilt from the runtimes.

get.summary: Read the agent's currently defined spec

put.summary: Serve a MediaMTX path, or change one
put.description: Direct agents only. Accepted once saved and handed to MediaMTX, not once it serves it: `system.get` says how far it has got.

409.description: The agent is configured by the studio, so its spec is not changed over this API; or MediaMTX is not running

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

422.description: The change would leave the spec invalid, such as two paths delivering the same exposure and rendition

delete.description: Direct agents only. Succeeds when there was no such path.
